recentItems.title: The Untold Truths of Operation Blue Star : Suresh Kochattil Exclusive Analysis | Indira Gandhi
recentItems.description:
#SureshKochattil, #OperationBlueStar, #1984History, #PunjabPolitics, #IndiraGandhi,#SoniaGandhi, #IndianHistory, #TurningPoints 
The Untold Truths of Operation Blue Star : Suresh Kochattil Exclusive Analysis | Indira Gandhi 


Renewed Debate Around Sonia Gandhi's Book & 1984: Suresh Kochattil examines how references to the Emergency and Operation Blue Star in Sonia Gandhi's memoir (Belonging: A Journey of Love) have reignited national discussion and political reactions.

Origins & Political Miscalculations Behind Blue Star: Traces the background of Punjab politics, SGPC dynamics, early grievances, how militancy gained ground, and why allowing a situation to fester proved costly.

Operation Blue Star & Military Realities: Discusses strategic assessments, intelligence warnings, defensive preparations inside the Akal Takht complex, heavy casualties, and the deep emotional and religious impact on the Sikh community.

Long-Term Aftermath & Tragedies: Reflects on the fallout of 1984—including subsequent violence, assassinations, and why prolonged conflict leaves lasting scars across generations.

Lessons for Punjab Today: Evaluates current concerns around radicalization, foreign funding, drugs, and governance, stressing the lesson of addressing threats early before they escalate.

recentItems.description:
#rodddamsrinivas #roddamsreenivas#TammareddyBharadwaja, #AdaniProject, #IndianExpress, #Investigation, #MiddleClassCrisis, #TaraliProject
5675 కోట్ల నుండి 56.75 కోట్లకు ఎలా తగ్గింది?|Tammareddy Bharadwaja About Adani Project Controversy?


Indian Express Report & Cost Reduction Row: Tammareddy Bharadwaja analyzes the investigation regarding Maharashtra's Tarali pumped storage project, where a ₹5,675 crore project figure was reportedly shown as ₹56.75 crore and the 4% wildlife/environmental deposit dropped from ₹227 crore to ₹2.27 crore.

Forest Department Complaint & Clarification: Covers the forest official's complaint, subsequent stop-work/clarification steps, and the explanation that the smaller figure related to survey/feasibility stages rather than full project execution.

Questions on Approvals & Accountability: Raises sharp points on how rapid approvals happen, transparency in public-private projects, and accountability toward taxpayers and regulatory bodies.

Corporate Growth vs. Middle-Class Strain: Contrasts big-ticket corporate projects and bank write-offs with middle-class financial stress, citing newspaper gold-loan auction notices affecting thousands of borrowers alongside rising living costs.

Freedom of Speech & Public Debate: Reflects on why citizens and commentators must be able to question policies and reports openly without labels or intimidation.
